<description>
Fixes #36483

As described in the linked issue, migration to descriptor wallets currently fails for legacy wallets that contain no spendable keys and are tracking watch-only transactions.

When a database transaction containing `RemoveTxs()` is aborted, the database rolls back and the registered `on_abort` callback is invoked. The current listener contains an empty `std::function` so calling it throws `std::bad_function_call` and masks the actual migration error.

The first commit changes the callback to a no-op function since no memory cleanup happens on abort. It also adds a unit test to confirm that abort restores the database record and leaves wallet memory unchanged.

After this commit, the [functional test](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36483) supplied by the issue's author reports `Error: Not all transaction records were migrated (-4)`, exposing the migration error previously masked by the abort callback exception.

During wallet migration, `RemoveTxs()` defers deletion of transactions from the original wallet's in-memory `mapWallet` until after the database commit. The current check that requires an empty map before the database commit causes migration  to fail.

The second commit checks that the transaction IDs left in the map exactly match those already scheduled to be removed in the `txids_to_delete` vector. If they match, migration continues and the `on_commit` callback removes those transactions from memory.

A new functional test is added to cover migration of a blank wallet with watch-only transactions. It checks that the destination watch-only wallet retains both transactions and balance, including after unloading and reloading the wallet, without rescanning the blockchain.
</description>

<commits>
e518ef26f4 fix(wallet): Handle abort of transaction removal

Aborting a RemoveTxs() transaction invokes an empty std::function, which
throws `std::bad_function_call`.

Implement a no-op abort callback since memory changes are deferred until
after database commit. Extend RemoveTxs coverage to verify rollback
restores the database record and leaves wallet memory unchanged.

6ed50582c1 fix(wallet): Fix watch-only migration failure

Removing transactions updates `mapWallet` only after database commit.
Requiring an empty map beforehand causes migration of legacy wallets
containing only watch-only transactions to fail.

Require all transactions in map to be those already scheduled for
removal. Add regression coverage to ensure transactions and balances are
preserved after migration and wallet reload without having to rescan
blockchain

Co-authored-by: David Gumberg <davidzgumberg@gmail.com>
</commits>

diff --git a/src/wallet/wallet.cpp b/src/wallet/wallet.cpp
index d6cc7ff728..cf31d32382 100644
--- a/src/wallet/wallet.cpp
+++ b/src/wallet/wallet.cpp
@@ -2292,7 +2292,7 @@ util::Result<void> CWallet::RemoveTxs(WalletBatch& batch, std::vector<Txid>& txs
         }
 
         MarkDirty();
-    }, .on_abort={}});
+    }, .on_abort= []() {}});
 
     return {};
 }
@@ -4063,7 +4063,13 @@ util::Result<void> CWallet::ApplyMigrationData(WalletBatch& local_wallet_batch,
     // migrated records will be presented to the user.
     if (!has_spendable_material) {
         if (!m_address_book.empty()) return util::Error{_("Error: Not all address book records were migrated")};
-        if (!mapWallet.empty()) return util::Error{_("Error: Not all transaction records were migrated")};
+
+        const std::set<Txid> pending_removals(txids_to_delete.begin(), txids_to_delete.end());
+        if (pending_removals.size() != mapWallet.size()) return util::Error{_("Error: Not all transaction records were migrated")};
+
+        for (const auto& [txid, wtx] : mapWallet) {
+            if (!pending_removals.contains(txid)) return util::Error{_("Error: Not all transaction records were migrated")};
+        }
     }
 
     return {}; // all good
diff --git a/src/wallet/test/wallet_tests.cpp b/src/wallet/test/wallet_tests.cpp
index de54302ef6..1b474746f7 100644
--- a/src/wallet/test/wallet_tests.cpp
+++ b/src/wallet/test/wallet_tests.cpp
@@ -45,6 +45,7 @@
 #include <wallet/spend.h>
 #include <wallet/test/util.h>
 #include <wallet/test/wallet_test_fixture.h>
+#include <wallet/walletdb.h>
 
 #include <boost/test/unit_test.hpp>
 
@@ -820,10 +821,29 @@ BOOST_FIXTURE_TEST_CASE(RemoveTxs, TestChain100Setup)
         BOOST_CHECK(wallet->mapWallet.contains(block_hash));
 
         std::vector<Txid> vHashIn{ block_hash };
-        BOOST_CHECK(wallet->RemoveTxs(vHashIn));
+        auto db_batch{wallet->GetDatabase().MakeBatch()};
+        const auto tx_key{std::make_pair(DBKeys::TX, block_hash)};
+        BOOST_REQUIRE(db_batch->Exists(tx_key));
+
+        // Confirm that aborting a RemoveTxs() transaction invokes the no-op listener
+        // callback safely and restores the transaction's database record
+        {
+            WalletBatch batch{wallet->GetDatabase()};
+            BOOST_REQUIRE(batch.TxnBegin());
+            BOOST_REQUIRE(wallet->RemoveTxs(batch, vHashIn));
+            BOOST_CHECK(wallet->HasWalletSpend(prev_tx));
+            BOOST_CHECK(wallet->mapWallet.contains(block_hash));
+            BOOST_CHECK(!db_batch->Exists(tx_key));
+            BOOST_REQUIRE(batch.TxnAbort());
+        }
+        BOOST_CHECK(wallet->HasWalletSpend(prev_tx));
+        BOOST_CHECK(wallet->mapWallet.contains(block_hash));
+        BOOST_CHECK(db_batch->Exists(tx_key));
 
+        BOOST_CHECK(wallet->RemoveTxs(vHashIn));
         BOOST_CHECK(!wallet->HasWalletSpend(prev_tx));
         BOOST_CHECK(!wallet->mapWallet.contains(block_hash));
+        BOOST_CHECK(!db_batch->Exists(tx_key));
     }
 
     TestUnloadWallet(std::move(wallet));
diff --git a/test/functional/wallet_migration.py b/test/functional/wallet_migration.py
index 6e032ae20d..d95f6d2b9c 100755
--- a/test/functional/wallet_migration.py
+++ b/test/functional/wallet_migration.py
@@ -1178,6 +1178,57 @@ class WalletMigrationTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
 
         wallet.unloadwallet()
 
+    def test_watchonly_txs_no_privkeys(self):
+        self.log.info("Test migrating a blank wallet with watch-only transactions and no spendable coins")
+        default = self.master_node.get_wallet_rpc(self.default_wallet_name)
+        wallet_name = "watchonly_no_privkeys"
+        wallet = self.create_legacy_wallet(wallet_name, blank=True)
+        key = get_generate_key()
+        addr = key.p2pkh_addr
+        wallet.importaddress(addr)
+
+        # Migrate blank legacy wallet to a dedicated watch-only descriptor wallet
+        # without dropping any watched transaction.
+        assert_equal(wallet.getwalletinfo()["private_keys_enabled"], True)
+        received_txids = [default.sendtoaddress(addr, amount) for amount in (10, 5)]
+        self.generate(self.master_node, 1)
+        transactions = {
+            txid: wallet.gettransaction(txid, include_watchonly=True)
+            for txid in received_txids
+        }
+
+        res, wallet = self.migrate_and_get_rpc(wallet_name)
+        assert_equal(res["wallet_name"], f"{wallet_name}_watchonly")
+        assert_equal(wallet.getwalletinfo()["private_keys_enabled"], False)
+        assert wallet_name not in self.master_node.listwallets()
+        assert wallet_name not in [entry["name"] for entry in self.master_node.listwalletdir()["wallets"]]
+
+        def check_transactions():
+            assert_equal(wallet.getaddressinfo(addr)["ismine"], True)
+
+            for txid, original in transactions.items():
+                migrated = wallet.gettransaction(txid)
+                for field in ("hex", "amount", "confirmations"):
+                    assert_equal(migrated[field], original[field])
+
+            assert_equal(wallet.getbalances()["mine"]["trusted"], Decimal("15"))
+
+        check_transactions()
+
+        # Reload wallet without rescanning to verify that transactions were persisted,
+        # rather than just copied into the descriptor wallet's in-memory mapWallet.
+        wallet.unloadwallet()
+
+        with self.master_node.assert_debug_log(
+            expected_msgs=[],
+            unexpected_msgs=["Rescanning"],
+        ):
+            self.master_node.loadwallet(res["wallet_name"])
+
+        wallet = self.master_node.get_wallet_rpc(res["wallet_name"])
+        check_transactions()
+        wallet.unloadwallet()
+
     def test_migrate_simple_watch_only(self):
         self.log.info("Test migrating a watch-only p2pk script")
         wallet = self.create_legacy_wallet("bare_p2pk", blank=True)
@@ -1788,6 +1839,7 @@ class WalletMigrationTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         self.test_avoidreuse()
         self.test_preserve_tx_extra_info()
         self.test_blank()
+        self.test_watchonly_txs_no_privkeys()
         self.test_migrate_simple_watch_only()
         self.test_manual_keys_import()
         self.test_p2wsh()

</patch>
